messages:
olivia: Heads-up — deploybot paused the promotion. Staging canaries failed during artifact uploads; we hit sustained slow writes into the shared cache/mirror and multipart uploads timed out.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused (reason: artifact_stream_backpressure).

logs:
```
upload error: write timeout after 30s
mirror: 503 slow down
cache: mru eviction spike, write queue growing
```

sam: I reproduced this in another run earlier. Cache shard #7 was draining slowly and uploader backpressure cascaded. Potential quick workarounds: lower multipart concurrency OR switch registry endpoint to eu-west-fallback.

maria: With the change window in ~40m, I'm leaning to pin to the last-good image and rerun CI after infra digs in. Less risky than rolling back.

olivia: +1. Pin to last-good sha and include a release note about the manual pin. Holding decision 10m in case ops has a hotfix.

sam: Created promo-pin PR: https://deploybot/internal/pins/2799999999 — pinned to sha256:fa3b7c9d. Note: "manual pin due to upload backpressure and cache eviction spike". Also set uploader concurrency to 4 for rerun.

ci-orchestrator-bot: Rerun queued on pinned image, pipeline #4821 (staged).

deploy-bot: Manual promotion locked until unpin command is issued. :lock: 

maria: Infra/oncall please investigate MRU eviction threshold tweaks or warming another shard. If shard drain improves we can unpin and promote inside the window. @infra-oncall

infra-oncall: Investigating. Seeing high write tail latencies on cache-shard-7, many small writes amplified by concurrent multipart uploads. Starting a temporary scale-up of the shard group and bumping write buffer.

olivia: Thanks — I'll update release notes: "Promo held: pinned to last-good image due to artifact upload backpressure; infra investigating cache shard drain." Marking cut as "held - pinned". If infra confirms fix, we can unpin and proceed.

sam: Adding postmortem checklist to the ticket: collect uploader logs, cache shard metrics (latency P50/P95/P99), multipart latency traces, registry 503 counts, and deploybot backpressure counters.

maria: Good. If infra can't stabilize within the window we'll reschedule promo to next change window and document the manual pin in release notes and the rollback plan.

olivia: Closing loop for now — promo pinned and blocked. Will post updates in #release-updates.
